subtasks.text: Farmers plant one-year-old asparagus crowns, which can produce for up to 20 years.
Farmers harvest asparagus daily, with each stalk potentially growing up to 10 inches per day.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the harvesting method and the use of specialized machinery.
subtasks.text: Specialized machinery is used to cut asparagus stalks without damaging the plant.
